Discover the NOXX Difference

At NOXX, we’re not your average cannabis dispensary. We’re led by NOXX, a friendly being from another galaxy who embodies our core value of inclusivity. NOXX understands that everyone has felt unfairly judged or excluded at some point, and the cannabis industry is no exception. That’s why we’ve created a space where everyone is welcome, regardless of their background or experience with marijuana.

When you visit our East Peoria dispensary, you’ll be greeted by our knowledgeable and friendly staff who are passionate about helping you find the perfect products to suit your needs. Whether you’re a seasoned cannabis connoisseur or a curious first-timer, we’ll guide you through our extensive menu and answer any questions you may have.

Our Premium Cannabis Selection

At NOXX E. Peoria, we pride ourselves on offering a curated selection of the finest cannabis products available. Our inventory includes:

  • Flower: Choose from a variety of premium strains, each with its own unique aroma, flavor, and effects.
  • Edibles: From gummies to chocolates, our edibles are a discreet and delicious way to enjoy the benefits of cannabis.
  • Concentrates: Our high-quality concentrates are perfect for those seeking a more potent cannabis experience.
  • Vapes: Enjoy the convenience and discretion of our vape cartridges and pens.
  • Topicals: Our topical products provide targeted relief for a variety of ailments.

No matter what your preferences are, our expert budtenders will help you find the perfect product to elevate your cannabis journey.

Retailer Occupation Tax (ROT): The ROT is a state sales tax that applies to the sale of tangible personal property, including cannabis. The base rate for ROT is 6.25%, but it can be higher in certain municipalities with additional local taxes.

Cannabis Purchaser Excise Tax: Consumers pay an excise tax on cannabis products. The tax rates vary depending on the type of product:

  • 25% for cannabis with a THC level at or below 35%
  • 40% for all cannabis-infused products
  • 30% for cannabis with a THC level above 35%

Additionally, municipalities have the authority to impose local taxes on cannabis sales.

The legal limits for cannabis possession and purchase are as follows:

In-State Customers:

  • Cannabis Flower: Adults can possess and purchase up to 60 grams (approximately two ounces) of cannabis flower.
  • Cannabis Concentrates: The legal limit for cannabis concentrates is up to 10 grams.
  • Cannabis-Infused Products: Adults can purchase and possess up to 1,000 milligrams of THC in cannabis-infused products, such as edibles.

Out-of-State Customers:

  • Cannabis Flower: Adults can possess and purchase up to 30 grams (approximately one ounce) of cannabis flower.
  • Cannabis Concentrates: The legal limit for cannabis concentrates is up to 5 grams.
  • Cannabis-Infused Products: Adults can purchase and possess up to 500 milligrams of THC in cannabis-infused products, such as edibles.

It’s only allowed in the privacy of your home or private property.
